sources.text: Search this site Embedded Files LEE LABORATORY TEAM Ellen E. Lee, MD Principal Investigator | Professor in Residence, Department of Psychiatry she/her Ellen E. Lee, MD, is the Estelle and Edgar Levi Memorial Chair in Aging, Professor, and Division Chief of Geriatric Psychiatry at the University of California, San Diego, and Staff Psychiatrist at the VA San Diego Healthcare System. Dr. Lee’s research focuses on biological and psychosocial aging in persons with schizophrenia and healthy aging populations, examining relationships between aging, sleep disturbances, cognition, loneliness, and metabolic health. Dr. Lee is the PI of an R01 award from the National Institute of Mental Health and grants from the Brain & Behavior Research Foundation, American Psychiatric Association, UCSD Academic Senate, Altman Clinical and Translational Research Institute, and Desert-Pacific Mental Illness Research, Education and Clinical Center. Postdoctoral Researchers Andrea Coppola Clinical Psychologist she/her I am currently an Advanced Fellow in the VA's Mental Illness Research, Education, and Clinical Center (MIRECC) and a Visiting Scholar in the Psychiatry Department at UCSD. I received my PhD in Clinical Psychology from the University of Arizona in 2024 and completed my predoctoral clinical internship at UCSD/VA San Diego. My research focuses on factors that impact social functioning in patients with Serious Mental Illness (SMI), including sleep and social cognition. In my free time, I love taking my Australian Cattle Dog on adventures, trying new restaurants, and playing various NYT word games. Emma Parrish Clinical Psychologist she/her I am currently an Advanced Fellow in the VA's Mental Illness Research, Education, and Clinical Center (MIRECC) and a Visiting Scholar in the Psychiatry Department at UCSD. I received my PhD in Clinical Psychology from the UCSD/SDSU Joint Doctoral Program in Clinical Psychology and completed my predoctoral clinical internship at the University of Washington School of Medicine. My research interests lie in understanding mechanisms related to suicide ideation and behavior among people with serious mental illness, as well as the development and implementation of psychosocial interventions for inpatient psychiatric settings. Outside of work, I enjoy rock climbing, hiking, traveling, and trying out new recipes Research Staff Jade Hawk Staff Research Manager s he/h er Hello, Everyone! I received my Bachelor of Arts in Psychology and Minor in Sociology from California State University, Long Beach, in 2020, and my Master of Arts in Psychology from San Diego State University in 2022. I have previous experience in project coordination, teaching, mentoring, and producing posters and a thesis. I have also worked with children, adolescents, young adults, older adults, and veterans. Before joining the Lee Laboratory, I was a Research Recruiter for the Green Laboratory at the West Los Angeles VA Hospital. In my spare time, I like to spend time with my Husband and my yellow Labrador Retriever, Goose. Nick Macias Phlebotomist/Recruiter he/him/they/them Hello! My name is Nick Macias and I am a Research Associate and Phlebotomist with the Lee Lab. I have been a licensed Phlebotomist and Lab technician for over 8 years, and have been working in research with UCSD for about 6. I received an associate's degree in Biology with an emphasis in Pre-Allied Health in 2020, and plan to transfer to a four year university to complete my Bachelors of Science in Nursing. I enjoy working with a wide variety of research participants, having worked on various studies over the years and look forward to building upon my research skills and applying those into a future career as a Nurse. In my spare time I enjoy hiking, watching movies and exploring new shops, cafes, and bookstores. Gia Renemae Calip Research Associate/Data Manager she/her Hello everyone! I was born in the Philippines and raised in Las Vegas. I earned my Bachelor of Arts in Psychology with a minor in Neuroscience in 2023 and my Master of Science in Data Analytics in Computer Science in 2025, both from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas. My research experience spans both my undergraduate and graduate studies, where I contributed to projects focused on serious mental health conditions such as schizophrenia and bipolar disorder, as well as work involving individuals who have undergone amputations. Outside of my academic and research interests, I enjoy going to the beach, traveling in and out of the country, arts and crafts, and cafe-hopping! Monica Galindo Research Associate she/her I graduated from UC San Diego in Spring 2026 with a double major in Public Health - Medicine Sciences and Molecular & Cell Biology. Before joining the Lee Lab, I volunteered with the Department of Psychiatry as a Research Assistant in the SALUD-Tech Lab, supporting research on digital markers of Alzheimer's disease risk in Hispanic/Latino adults, and with the Department of Emergency Medicine as a Research Associate through the FMP-EMRA Program. Outside of work, I enjoy spending time with my family and being outdoors, no matter the season! Undergraduate Employees Lea Woodruff Student Employee she/her Hi! I am a second-year undergraduate majoring in Neurobiology and minoring in Cognitive Sciences at UCSD. My research focus lies in psychiatry and I plan on attending medical school to become a Psychiatrist. I grew up in Berlin and New York City. In my free time, I love baking sweets, reading at the beach, going on hikes and lifting at the gym. Kaijie Wen EPRP Mobile App Developer he / him I am a current third-year Math-CS, student at UCSD. I'm passionate about building products and technology that bring convenience to everyone's daily lives. Outside of school and work, I am a part-time electronic music producer/DJ, and I own a music label! Medical Students Candi Zhao Medical Student Volunteer she/her I am a medical student at the California University of Science and Medicine, and I graduated in 2023 from Rice University with a degree in Biosciences and a minor in Neuroscience. I'm currently interested in Psychiatry, and have been involved in various research projects surrounding Alzheimer's Disease, caregiving burden, and aging. When I have free time, I love to crochet, try new recipes, and listen to true crime and mystery podcasts! Graduate Students Rocky Jacobs Graduate Student Volunteer she/her I am currently a Master's in Public Health student concentrating in Public Mental Health. In 2024, I received my Bachelor's degrees in Psychology and Recording Arts from Loyola Marymount University, where I developed a deep interest in studying serious mental illness (SMI). After graduation, my work in a federally qualified health center inspired me to investigate how structural determinants impact SMI outcomes in underserved populations through a community psychiatry lens. When I'm not researching, you can find me training for triathlons and hanging out with my cat, Duncan! Undergraduate Students Beatte Kim Research Volunteer she/her I’m a fourth-year Human Biology major at UCSD, currently involved in research projects exploring the relationship between schizophrenia and other physical health conditions. My passion for supporting individuals with mental health challenges has inspired my interest in pursuing Psychiatry and attending medical school. I’ve lived in Singapore, Australia, and Korea, and love to travel and experience new cultures. Outside of academics, I enjoy reading and spending time with my two dogs, Haru and Namu, especially on long walks. Ashley Chung Research Volunteer she/her Hello! I am a second-year Cognitive Science major with a specialization in Behavioral Neuroscience at UCSD. After serving as a therapy aid at an acute psychiatric unit in my hometown of San Francisco, my passion for mental health and health equity deepened, further shaping my desire to become a future Psychiatrist who supports patients with severe cognitive disorders. Beyond academia, I was a former competitive dancer and figure skater. I also love music festivals, SoulCycle, and tanning at the beach! A yanei Matienzo Research Volunteer she/her I am a second-year Cognitive Science major with a minor in Biology at UCSD. My spirit for clinical research has been something deeply rooted in me far before undergrad. A personal connection in my teen years sparked my interest in mood and psychotic disorders. I plan to extend this interest through my education by pursuing my PhD and conducting meaningful research. Being able to volunteer at this lab has brought me one step closer to that! Outside of academia I enjoy reading books to nurture my collection, volunteering at the g-store coop, and spending time with the people I love! Carter Wilson Research Volunteer he/him I am a third-year Biochemistry and Molecular Biology major at UC Davis. Through my experience volunteering in several UC San Diego Health Emergency rooms, I have become particularly interested in studying abnormal psychology and the biological mechanisms underlying psychiatric disorders. In the future, I hope to pursue an MD/PhD and combine clinical practice with research and teaching. Extracurricularly, I serve as an officer for the UC Davis Waterski Club, enjoy distance running and hiking, and love to play guitar and sing. Laboratory Alumni Paulyn Kwak Study Coordinator she/her I received a B.A. from Bowdoin College in 2021 with a major in Neuroscience and a minor in Sociology. In my time with the Lee Lab, I have recruited participants, conducted assessments, and collected sleep data for Dr. Lee's SNOOZE study. I am currently coordinating the SNOOZE and Psychosis and Aging study, as well as preparing for the launch of the PAP treatment trial. Additionally, I have worked on collecting sleep data on the UCSD Stein Institute's MIDAS and SZR01 studies using FitBits and home sleep testing devices. I'm originally from Hayward, CA, but I grew up in Phoenix, AZ. I love baking, exploring San Diego, and taking road trips whenever I have the chance! Arren Ramsey Study Coordinator he/they I have a bachelor’s degree in Molecular Biology and have learned a lot in Ellen’s lab, working on multiple projects relating to loneliness, compassion, and physical health in people with schizophrenia and in older adults. Currently, I work as a junior research specialist at UCSF investigating the role of astrocytes in the pathology of frontotemporal dementia and plan to apply to biomedical neuroscience PhD programs in the upcoming cycle. Alexa Hernandez Study Coordinator she/her I graduated from UCLA in 2019 with a B.S. in psychobiology. During my first two years post-grad, I worked as a medical scribe in a cardiology and primary care clinic. I worked with Dr. Lee for 1.5 years collecting sleep data in the UCSD Stein Institute's IBM and SZR01 studies. I focused on launching her Impact of Sleep Disturbances on Health in Schizophrenia (SNOOZE) study and the sleep pap trial study. My hobbies include running, yoga, exploring new national parks, and local coffee shops here in San Diego. Stephanie Ibrahim Research Associate she/her Hello! My name is Stephanie and I am a college graduate from UC Santa Cruz with a B.S. in Cognitive Science and a B.A. in Psychology. I am from Los Angeles and recently moved to San Diego. I am interested in working with individuals who have severe mental illnesses and learning about the different impacts it can have on their cognition and daily life. I will ultimately purse a PhD in Clinical Psychology. In my spare time, when I'm not in the lab, I enjoy going to the beach and trying new restaurants. Jerry McDonald Research Associate he/him I'm a graduate from the University of California, Irvine with a Psychology, B.A. My hope is to strengthen my research skills among the various studies on sleep and aging conducted by the Lee Lab before applying to a PhD program in developmental neuroscience. In my free time, I enjoy reading manga and light novels such as One Piece, 86, and Hirayasumi as well as PC gaming. Marisa Zimmerman Research Associate she/her I'm originally from Santa Clarita, California and obtained my B.S. in Cognitive and Behavioral Neuroscience and a minor in Law and Society from UC San Diego. I am very interested in the neural mechanisms of neurological disorders and how they affect behavior and cognition. I plan to pursue a PhD in Neuroscience in the future. In my free time, I like to read, play music, and go to the beach. Zainab Butt Undergraduate Researcher she/her I'm an undergraduate second year (upcoming third year) at UCSD studying Human Biology. I'm a pre-med who's interested in a wide-variety of fields, including psychiatry, cardiology, and orthopedics. In my free time, I like to try new foods, explore new places with friends, and read. A fun fact about me is that I'm Pakistani and am bilingual. Siyuan (Jack) Chen Undergraduate Researcher he/him I'm from China Xi'an, I'm currently a senior undergraduate student at UCSD. My personal interests are body building and weight lifting. My future plan is to apply for a Ph.D. in Psychology. A fun fact about me would be that I am scared of bugs! Hayden Palmer Undergraduate Researcher he/him I’m a lifelong San Diegan. I am currently pursuing a degree in Integrative Biology at UC Berkeley (Class of 2023), where I get to study environmental and human biology. After graduation, I plan to go to medical school and become a physician. Claire Liu EPRP Mobile App Developer she/her Hi! I'm a 4th year computer science student at UCSD. My tech interests lie in NLP, backend software development, and virtual reality. Outside of computer science, I'm a passionate mental health advocate and am interested in psychiatry, psychology, and cognitive science. In my free time, I like to create digital paintings and go to concerts and music festivals. Andrew Park EPRP Mobile App Developer he/ him I am a third year Computer Engineering student at UC San Diego. I was born in North Carolina, but I lived mostly in Seoul, South Korea. During my free time, I love to play tennis and participate in local tournaments for fun. Yinong (Emily) Xu EPRP Mobile App Developer s he/ her Hello! I am a recent graduate in Computer Engineering from UC San Diego, and an incoming graduate student in Computer Science at UC San Diego. My interests are backend development and database development. I love road trips, board games, swimming and playing badminton. Veronica Hernandez Student Employee she/her Hi! I’m a fourth-year undergraduate at UC San Diego double-majoring in Clinical Psychology and Cognitive & Behavioral Neuroscience, with a minor in Computational Social Science. I’m from San Bernardino, CA, and my research interests are in using and developing biomarkers to preserve brain health in neurodegenerative and neuropsychiatric disorders, as well as understanding how cognition is impacted among these disorders. I plan to pursue a PhD in Clinical Psychology and aspire to become a Clinical Neuropsychologist. In my spare time, I enjoy playing the violin and watching my favorite shows. Sanchit Goel Graduate Student Volunteer he/him Hello, I'm Sanchit! Currently, I am pursuing my graduate studies in Data Science at UCSD. Prior to my master's program, I worked as a data scientist at an AI consulting company, concentrating on developing NLP solutions for healthcare clients. My passion lies in harnessing the potential of data to improve healthcare outcomes, with a particular focus on advancing mental health diagnosis and treatment. Ashley Dang Research Volunteer she/her I am a rising high school senior from Westchester, NY! I participate in a science research program and work with the lab for my research project! I hope to continue doing research in college as well. Kie Fujii Medical Student Volunteer she/her When I was working with Dr. Lee, I was a fourth-year medical student and completed my undergraduate degree at UC Berkeley. I was applying to psychiatry residency programs this cycle. Since I had flexibility in my final year of schooling, I was also taking business courses for her MBA and assisting the Lee Lab to enhance my skills in the field of research. Fun fact: I was blessed by Mother Teresa when I was a newborn. Eric Sah Medical Student Volunteer he/him I am currently a fourth-year medical student at Jefferson and graduated from the University of Notre Dame with a B.S. in Applied and Computational Mathematics and Statistics with a minor in studio art. During medical school, I completed the MSTAR program at Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine where I did research on frontotemporal dementia. I plan to apply to psychiatry residency programs and am excited to do more research in psychiatry with Dr. Lee. My hobbies include playing the clarinet and weightlifting. Jaifreen Bhangu Medical Student Volunteer she/her I am currently a medical student at the University of California, San Diego and graduated from UCLA with a degree in Psychobiology in 2022. At UCSD, I lead the Psychiatry Student Interest Group and the Human Rights Clinic. In my free time, I enjoy reading, dancing, and spending time with my family. Ha Mieu Ho Medical Student Volunteer she/her I am a medical student with budding interest
